question: Jhum cultivation or shifting cultivation is also known by the name of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Slash and burn agriculture.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jhum cultivation or (shifting cultivation) is also known as slash and burn agriculture because it involves clearing a patch of land by cutting down and burning the vegetation before planting crops.**
